collision_analysis.method: TF-IDF cosine over description text plus exact-match on quoted trigger phrases
collision_analysis.caveat: TF-IDF over descriptions is a proxy for activation, not the mechanism itself. Strong evidence against collision, not proof.

eval_13_determinism.defect: size subcommand had no forward mode. A user with a known list size could not be answered through the script, forcing prose arithmetic and violating quality gate 6 (all arithmetic goes through gtm_math.py).
eval_13_determinism.fix: Added --prospects as a mutually exclusive alternative to --meetings-goal. Backward mode regression-tested.

script_determinism_suite.validate_spintax: pass (both dialects, structural-cascade suppression, unknown-var detection)
script_determinism_suite.gtm_math: pass (size both modes, economics, ab, ab-eval; ab and ab-eval mutually consistent)
script_determinism_suite.chain_integration: pass (clay vars -> spintax --vars catches unmapped column)

activation_routing.blocker: Activation is resolved by the harness at session start from installed skill descriptions. Cannot be tested until gtm-outbound is installed and a new session starts.
activation_routing.proxy_available: collision_analysis covers the negative case; positive routing needs a live session

output_quality_grading.blocker: Requires skill-forge-executor and skill-forge-grader subagent runs (with_skill vs baseline). Not spawned -- awaiting user decision.
output_quality_grading.note: These do NOT require installation; an executor agent can read the SKILL.md files directly.
